purpose: Doc AI product delivery children under existing master requirements; offline coordination of a separate builder swarm. This plan neither executes tickets nor enables a provider.

scope.product: Document intake, source identity, native parsing, candidate evidence, review, accepted output and a later optional provider connection.
scope.builder_boundary: Reuse the existing L1-L4/SW-00/SW-13 builder organization, skills library, learning and durable PROJECT_INTERNAL job patterns; do not embed that swarm in the Doc AI runtime.
scope.child_id_policy: BR-DOC IDs are stable local delivery child identifiers under existing BR-ENG parents, not replacement epics or claims that external tracker issues were created.
scope.existing_84_plan: Historical acquisition-oriented capability work remains separate; no completion status is inherited into this Doc AI plan.
scope.source_policy: Use approved generic contracts and stable parent references only. Private source text, URLs, personal finances and document content stay outside this repository.

capability_status.engine: Implemented and locally tested neutral contracts, preserved native filing, bounded format readers, one invoice grammar and append-only local review projection. Authenticated ACLs/retention and durable jobs remain open.
capability_status.application: Implemented and locally tested synchronous local intake, inspect, review/correction and accepted export CLI. Actor labels are local attestations; the broader service and Gate A are incomplete.
capability_status.provider: NVIDIA Parse 2.4 selected as the disabled future client target. Neutral provenance contracts exist; generic seam, selected client and live connection remain unimplemented/unverified.
capability_status.deployment: No model download, live provider invocation or production deployment was performed. Builders remain outside the runtime.

resource_notes.agents: One dedicated SW-00 integrator plus at most three concurrent workers. L1-L4 and SW-13 name lanes; they are not additional concurrent slots.
resource_notes.hardware: CUDA and R capacity are zero until actual runtime evidence changes the profile. Worker slots do not imply CPU cores or GPU devices.
resource_notes.providers: Hosted inference has no automatic local-GPU prerequisite. Self-hosted GPU runs need separately observed CUDA capacity and compatible model/runtime configuration.

ownership.L1_evidence: Existing L1 intelligence/ontology lane: evidence contracts, identity and source/field semantics.
ownership.L2_engineering: Existing L2 engineering/interoperability lane: parsers, adapters, compatibility and compute.
ownership.L3_quality: Existing L3 capital/risk lane applied to evaluation error, cost, data rights and independent analytical checks.
ownership.L4_workflow: Existing L4 execution/operations lane: intake, review, service workflows and monitored operation.
ownership.SW-00_integrator: Existing coordinator/integrator: dispatch, file ownership, resource replanning and evidence-based promotion.
ownership.SW-13_independent_review: Existing independent reviewer, distinct from implementation authors; SW-00 accepts the reviewed gate record.

provider_policy.activation_rule: A generic mock or valid manifest is not a real provider implementation or connection. Gate C requires the independently reviewed BR-DOC-012 selected client plus verified endpoint/auth/version/data-policy/budget/timeout/provenance and test permission; Gate D is separate.
provider_policy.connector_rule: A ChatGPT cloud connector is a chat capability, not an authenticated connection in this application backend.

scheduling_policy.estimate_basis: All point estimates and ranges are planning assumptions for scoped builder effort. Simulated relative schedules are not calendar bookings, measured speed, delivery commitments or production throughput.
scheduling_policy.priority_order: Lower priority number first, then remaining critical-path estimate, then stable child ID.
scheduling_policy.owner_rule: One active ticket per owner lane; all L1-L4/SW-13 work consumes the same three-worker pool and overlapping write scopes serialize.
scheduling_policy.completion_rule: A worker hands off revision, paths, exact commands, criterion-to-evidence mapping, failures and limitations. Independent SW-13 review and SW-00 promotion precede completed status; effective prerequisites must also be complete.
scheduling_policy.tracking_rule: Mirror approved execution work into the existing PROJECT_INTERNAL durable ticket register with version/CAS and reviewed closure. Do not use the business transaction state machine for builder work.
scheduling_policy.phase_rule: Enabled planning phases only determine offline schedule visibility; they do not activate APIs, agents, downloads or providers. Explicit live holds remain effective.
scheduling_policy.replan_rule: Recompute after evidence, blocker, resource, owner, estimate or scope changes; do not increase concurrency to bypass a failed contract or review gate.

A.meaning: Local native extraction, source lineage and human review work without AI.

B.meaning: The disabled generic seam and offline mock contract are independently checked early; the selected actual client has its own BR-DOC-012 offline conformance requirement.

C.meaning: Limited synthetic/permitted-test live evaluation after A, B, the implemented version-pinned selected client with independently reviewed offline conformance, preflight and adverse-case checks; no production activation.

D.meaning: Separately enabled monitored production canary with accepted release, data scope, budgets and rollback.

roadmap.outcome: Extend existing audit/boundary/crosswalk evidence with canonical execution workspace, provenance and ownership decisions; fixture work can start beside coordination.
Build native provenance/jobs and the disabled provider contract concurrently within owner/write limits.
Demonstrate the reviewable local slice; implement and register one disabled version-pinned provider client, review its offline conformance and prepare fail-closed preflight.
Only when verified preconditions and permitted test scope exist; candidate quality can fail or remain insufficient.
Connector contracts, telemetry, reviewed consumer outputs and incremental class coverage; release review is evidence-gated.
Retrieval, executed R/CUDA measurements, historical source reconciliation and production pilot retain explicit prerequisites and holds.

tickets.title: Gate D: conduct a separately enabled monitored production pilot
tickets.estimate_basis: Assumed active builder effort for one scoped increment; not measured throughput, elapsed delivery time or a production capacity claim.
acceptance_criteria: Enable only the approved release, deployment target, document classes, users/data sources and provider manifest; verify effective authorization and budgets before live production traffic.
Start at a small bounded canary with human review, traceable usage/cost, error/coverage thresholds, alerts, stop controls and a demonstrated rollback.

Report connection state, supported scope and deployment evidence accurately; no automatic negotiation, messages, property acquisition or runtime agent swarm is introduced.
Production activation is a distinct later step. This plan and any synthetic test do not enable production or establish two-million-household capacity.
